real_s1.explanation: Within its top classes, this unit responds most to a single, sharply focused main subject, especially one facing toward or away from the camera. It is weaker on blurry subjects and on cluttered scenes with no single main subject. It also prefers photos without a warm color tint and subjects that fill a moderate part of the frame. The sharpness and facing-the-camera effects are the most particular to it, since its similar units do not share them strongly.

Its preference for sharpness and for head-on subjects is stronger than that of its similar units. Its dislike of scenes with no main subject is partly shared with them.
